
The main shrine of Watatsumi is [[Shikaumi Shrines]] the ancestral shrine of the [[Azumi people]]

'''Kaijin Shrine''' (海神社, also read as Amajinja, Kaijinja, or Watatsumijinja) refers to various [[Shrine|Shinto shrines]]:

* [[Watatsumi Shrine_(Kobe)|Watatsumi Shrines]] - Located in {{ill|Tarumi-ku, Kobe|ar|تارومي-كو|ceb|Tarumi Ku|de|Tarumi-ku (Kōbe)|fa|تارومی-کو، کوبه|fr|Tarumi-ku|id|Tarumi-ku, Kobe|it|Tarumi-ku|ja|垂水区|kab|Tarumi-ku|ko|다루미구|ru|Таруми-ку (Кобе)|th|เขตทารูมิ|tr|Tarumi|zh|垂水區|qid=Q1078806|lt=Tarumi-ku, Kobe}}, {{ill|Kobe|en|Kobe|qid=Q48320|lt=Kobe}}, {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|en|Hyōgo Prefecture|qid=Q130290|lt=Hyōgo Prefecture}}.
